thread:
liz: Heads up — we need a cross-team plan to ingest KV & prefix cache signals into Console dashboards. Need runtime + infra owners to align on schema, cardinality, and freshness SLAs. Proposed minimal set below. pinging @carlos @dina @ryan

carlos: we already emit kv_hits/kv_misses from runtime, but labels are all over the place (model, shard, workload, instance). can we standardize to avoid explosion?

dina: infra can add ingestion pipeline for new metrics. we need exact metric names, types (counter/gauge), and max cardinality per minute. retention/downsampling requirements too.

liz: Proposed metrics (suggested names + labels):
```
redwood_kv_cache_hits_total{model,workload,shard}
redwood_kv_cache_misses_total{model,workload,shard}
redwood_kv_prefix_matches_total{model,workload,prefix_len_bucket}
redwood_kv_evictions_total{reason,model,shard}
redwood_kv_cache_size_bytes{shard}
redwood_kv_reuse_raw{model,workload} # emit sample events; derive ratio offline
redwood_kv_warm_fraction{model}
redwood_kv_cold_start_count{model}
```
(also want avg_kv_ttl gauge and per-model request_rate_by_model)

ryan: for reuse ratio — prefer deriving in a batch job. runtime emits reuse_raw increments (low cardinality) and we compute reuse_by_workload in analytics. avoids heavy labels at ingest.

infra-bot: deploy plan created: infra/metrics/kvcache-ingest v1 -> waiting for schema PR.

carlos: can we get example cardinality estimates? e.g., model ~30, workloads ~500, shards ~50 -> naive combinatorial label space ~750k series which is too much.

dina: yep that would blow up. suggestions: aggregate shard -> shard_bucket, sample low-traffic workloads, or emit a workload_hash and only expand in analytics. also add cardinality guards in scrape/ingest.

liz: UX needs: per-model dashboard, per-workload heatmap for reuse, time-series for hit_rate/evictions, and an alerting rule: if hit_rate drops >10% vs baseline over 1h then rollback/notify. need to capture baseline computation method.

sam: I'll run an eval job to compute baseline hit rates per workload over the last 30 days and post results. should help set sensible alert thresholds.

carlos: runtime action: standardize metric naming + stop emitting instance-specific labels. add a tiny shim to roll up shard -> shard_bucket. ETA end of week. :+1:

dina: infra action: add ingestion config, retention policy, and downsampling for high-cardinality tag combos. will also add cardinality meter to monitor series growth. ETA Tue next week.

ryan: I'll draft the batch transformation for reuse_by_workload and a job to compute warm_fraction. will include example SQL and expected output schema.

liz: Great. Action items recap:
- carlos: runtime metric PR (names + label strategy)
- ryan: backfill/batch plan for reuse ratio derivation
- dina: ingestion config + cardinality guard + retention
- sam: baseline eval dataset + results
I'll add this to eng-platform weekly and spin up a tiny kickoff doc. :rocket:

infra-bot: linked tickets: METR-2345, INGEST-881, DASH-412

carlos: one more ask — can Console team specify the exact dashboard widgets (heatmap, stacked area, table) so infra can produce the pre-aggregates we need?

liz: yes — I'll draft widget list and wireframes in the doc. will share by EOD tomorrow.

dina: ok locking this plan. will validate with ops for cost impact before enabling full retention.

sam: FYI I'll seed the eval with 7 days first to sanity-check cardinality numbers before the full 30d run.

liz: thanks all — let's keep discussions here and move implementation details into the PRs/tickets.
